This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a teal background and a red vertical bar on the left. The masthead "TEMPO" is in large white letters across the top. Two men with red-toned skin are shown from the chest up, wearing white collared shirts. They are positioned close together, and their heads are literally connected by a single blue surgical face mask that stretches horizontally across both of their mouths. The mask's white elastic loops go around the outer ears of each man. The man on the left has his eyes closed, while the man on the right wears wire-rimmed glasses and looks forward.

Below them, bold black text reads "TERGAGAP CORONA". Smaller black text underneath states: "CARA PEMERINTAH MENANGANI WABAH COVID-19 MEMBUAT PUBLIK PANIK. KOORDINASI PRESIDEN JOKO WIDODO DAN MENTERI KESEHATAN TERAWAN BELEPOTAN."

At the top, smaller text reads "NADIEM BICARA SOAL KAMPUS MERDEKA / TAIPAN KAKAP DI SKANDAL JIWASRAYA". The The bottom right includes a date "9-15 MARET 2020", price, barcode, and website. A QR code is in the bottom left.
